answer: A code-based commitment binds a message to a codeword of an error-correcting code, and opening it means revealing positions that match the codeword and decode to the claimed message. A basalt wall of copied codewords cannot pass, since the ridge between a valid codeword and a forgery is measured in Hamming distance, and the nadir of a farm is that every fake opening must be a distinct valid codeword, which costs real encoding work per account.
